audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Cho'Gath owns the '2+ items' row, but the packet chart says Kassadin, and every prose field in both layers (late, whys[6], spikes[3]) says he out-scales.
audit.why: Kassadin at two items has a short-cooldown Riftwalk that blinks over Rupture's telegraph and out of Feral Scream's 300-range cone, plus Force Pulse burst. Carry rating on the page is already 9.5/10. Headline 49.72% over 362 games is an even lane precisely because Cho'Gath owns lane and Kassadin owns the game.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flips to Kassadin (rating 4/10). Rows 1 through First item stay Cho'Gath/Skill as written — that half of the chart matches the prose and the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is written as a pure Cho'Gath spike ('Feast stacks turn you into terrain'). It ignores that Riftwalk arrives on the same level and is the reason the row is rated Skill.
audit.why: Both champions spike at 6. Feast is 80s at rank 1, true damage, 175 range — Void Stone's magic reduction and the Null Sphere shield do nothing to it. Riftwalk is 7s base at rank 1 but its cost doubles per recast, so the first blink is cheap and the second is not.
audit.corrected: Rewrite phases[4].why so it states the true-damage/175-range fact and the Riftwalk-dodges-Rupture fact together. Cho'Gath's other spikes (levels 2-3, Heartsteel) are correct as written.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks Riftwalk in a dozen fields and never once names Feral Scream, even though the silence is the interaction that beats Kassadin. 'Key Ability Interactions' says only 'track Riftwalk, kill him before it scales'.
audit.why: A silenced target cannot cast Riftwalk. Feral Scream is 11s at rank 1 on a 300-range cone — that is the punishable window in this lane, not Rupture, which is 6s flat at every rank and therefore always available. Feast is true damage, so Void Stone (magic damage reduction) and the Null Sphere shield read zero against it.
audit.corrected: State the silence-locks-Riftwalk interaction in report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns with the real 11s / 300-range / 80s numbers, and fix dosFull[2]'s description so it matches its own title.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is placeholder text — 'your committal tool', 'your ultimate' — with no ability names and no numbers.
audit.why: Rupture is 6s at every rank, so 'engage on its cooldown' is advice nobody can act on. Feral Scream (11s) and Feast (80/70/60s) are the cooldowns that actually gate commitment.
audit.corrected: Replace with the three real cooldowns and what each one buys.

audit.why: The content layer already carries the non-obvious point: Void Stone reduces the magic damage of Rupture, Feral Scream and Vorpal Spikes, so baiting the Null Sphere shield with a Vorpal Spikes auto before committing Q-W is real value.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: his escape at 6, and Feral Scream's silence locks it — that is the whole lane. - Feral Scream: 11s at rank 1, a 300-range cone; that is your real window. - Rupture is 6s flat, so never wait on it.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — Q-knockup + Feast the kill.
edits.after: Feral Scream silences, and a silenced Kassadin cannot Riftwalk. Feast is true damage — Void Stone and his shield both read zero.

edits.before: Kassadin wastes Riftwalk — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: A silenced Kassadin cannot cast Riftwalk — scream before you Rupture.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kassadin's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast is true damage at 175 range, so Void Stone and his shield read zero — but Riftwalk now blinks over Rupture, so land the silence first, then close.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath vs Kassadin - Track: Kassadin Riftwalk. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Riftwalk's cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath vs Kassadin - Track: Riftwalk — Feral Scream's silence locks it. - Keep the wave on your side. - Feast is true damage at 175. - Don't chase past the wave.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kassadin carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on he blinks over Rupture on a short Riftwalk and rotates your back line. Carry threat 9.5/10 — frontline, don't chase.

notes: FLAG MISFIRE: champ-data/_kits/chogath.json tags Rupture (Q) with 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes', but Riot's own description says only that it pops units into the air and slows. I wrote nothing about grounding here — a false grounding line would be actively dangerous against Kassadin, since it would tell the player Riftwalk is disabled by standing in the circle. SUSPECT NAME FALSE POSITIVE: the packet flags "Feral Scream's" in spikes[0].text; that is the correct Riot name and needs no change. LEVEL CHART: the '2+ items' flip to Kassadin is proposed in both layers together (full phases[6].side/.rating and content win[6]) as one atomic group; rows 0-5 are already correct and untouched.
